title: Wonderful Food and History Tour!
text:
My husband, two friends, and I had a wonderful food tour with our guide, Bella. The meeting location was very convenient, and from the start, Bella was warm, engaging, and incredibly knowledgeable about both the local history and gastronomy.

One thing we especially appreciated was how well Bella and the restaurants accommodated the different dietary preferences in our group. Two of us are vegetarians, while the others prefer meat and don’t eat seafood, and everyone had plenty of delicious food to enjoy. We never felt like anyone was missing out because of their dietary preferences.

The tour
author: lisasH939FW

title: Not just a tapas tour, it's so much more!
text: This was such a fun tour!  Our guide Bella met us in front of Mercat de Santa Caterina where the tour began.  It was great having a local take us around each stall in the market and explain how it all works.  From there we went to three different places for tapas and drinks in the Born district.  This was so much more than a tapas tour though!  Our guide went at a leisurely pace and pointed out points of interest between all our stops. title: Well worth going

title: Foodie Treat
text:
Alejandra was amazing. We went to wonderful local places and had wonderful local foods. Her explanations about the history of the neighborhoods and the local foods made it fun for not only us but our three granddaughters who are 21, 17 and 16.  I would definitely recommend this tour and most especially Alejandra to anyone.

Sandy
author: 845sandyk

title: Perfect tour
text:
Our guide Alejandra was excellent. We were a group of 5, my wife and I and three granddaughters aged 21 to 16. Alejandra made it fun and informative for all of us. The granddaughters were as thrilled with the tour as we were. We went to three restaurants and tried some great tapas and drinks in each restaurant. Between our food stops Alejandra kept us interested with lots of insider information about Barcelona.
Overall a wonderful tour.
author: B5174NMdavidk

title: Like a being shown Barcelona by a family member!
text: Alejandra provided us a wonderful and personal history of the Born neighborhood and Catalonia. She took us to her favorite places and shared her favorite dishes and drinks. We were the only tourists in each place and we were welcomed warmly.
author: lauragJ4891UN

title: Alejandra is fantastic
text: Alejandra is a fantastic companion and she is knowledgeable about the good and the history of the area. She is a joy to spend time with. We really loved our adventure.
author: randallh703

title: Alejandra Connected Our Hearts to Barcelona!!
text: We had so much fun with Alejandra while exploring, learning, and connecting to Barcelona’s unique culture, history, and joy through food, market tapas, and her depth of knowledge. As a halo effect of her engaging personality, we were welcomed like locals in of all the extraordinary places she took us, She graciously accommodated dietary needs and made sure we had the best time together. It was a highlight of our Barcelona trip.
author: LyndaC-Traveling
